csv_scope_of_work: The Murrieta Housing Authority is requesting written proposals from qualified consultants or consulting firms to assist with various general housing tasks. The Housing Authority is soliciting proposals and statements of qualifications from highly qualified and experienced firms to provide Housing general consultant services to assist with various housing tasks including, but not limited to, annual reporting, statutory payment calculations, other financial-related services, evaluation of economic and market feasibility studies of proposed development projects, preparation and/or review of financial and proforma analysis, real estate advisory and negotiation services, implementation agreements and special services, site assembly coordination, relocation services, affordable housing project services including strategies, compliance strategy plans and monitoring deed restriction services, income qualifications of affordable housing units, preparing agenda materials, and special project activities, and preparation of agenda materials and related reports for hearing. On-Call As Needed Consultant Services to assist with expanding housing options and meet the needs identified in its current Housing Element and the demand among very low and low-income households. Assist with the implementation of the Revolving Loan Fund program including the initial loans of the program and the next phase of its long term housing goals.
